ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity white dominates approximately 92% of the visible ventral surface area, with low-intensity black pixels localized to the peripheral margins and peduncle attachment point.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous narrow band along the trailing edge and outer tips; a distinct irregular dark cluster is visible at the inferior medial point (peduncle junction).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate internal angle of 48 degrees and a shallow depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations with an amplitude of 3-7 pixels; irregular jagged peaks are more pronounced on the left lobe trailing edge relative to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a slightly concave trajectory near the notch transitioning to a linear sweep toward the tips; distal outer margins are convex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, non-symmetrical indentation/notch is visible on the distal trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately 15% from the outer tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, high-contrast dark focal spot is located on the lower left lobe approximately 10 pixels above the waterline.
